name: Form of the Phoenix
body:
School transmutation (polymorph) [fire]; Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 8, cleric/oracle 8, druid 8, shaman 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of phoenix blood)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw see below; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell was devised by the jyoti, to allow themselves to assume the shape of their majestic phoenix relatives.

When casting this spell, you assume the form of a Gargantuan phoenix. This works as beast shape IV, except as noted below.

You gain the following abilities: a +10 size bonus to Strength, -6 size penalty to Dexterity, +6 size bonus to Constitution, a +19 natural armor bonus, fly 120 feet (good), darkvision 90 feet, damage reduction 10/evil, low-light vision, immunity to fire, and vulnerability to cold. You also gain one bite (2d8), two claws (2d6), regeneration 10 (cold or evil), and shroud of flame as supernatural abilities.

Shroud of flame allows you to cause your feathers to blast into fire as a free action for 1 round per caster level in the spell’s duration. These rounds have not to be consecutive.

While your feathers are burning, you inflict an additional 1d6 points of fire damage with each natural attack, and any creature within 20 feet must make a DC 25 Reflex save each round to avoid taking 4d6 points of fire damage at the start of its turn. A creature that attacks you with natural or non-reach melee weapons takes 1d6 points of fire damage (no save) with each successful hit. The save DC is Constitution-based.
